comparison.objective: Move museum tankards one at a time by their bodies; the candidate performs gripper calibration.
comparison.physical_skill: Careful grasping and sequential transport of fragile artifacts under grasp-location constraints, not threaded adjustment.

comparison.reason: Artifact transport is unrelated to the candidate's mechanism.
